content.title: Fortnite Brainrot 7 skins leaked with prices & release date
content.text: No, this is not an April Fools joke. The Fortnite Brainrot set is real, it is coming, and dataminers have already pulled the full cosmetic lineup from the game’s files. Following months of rumors and an initial tease back in February, the April 1, 2026 Fortnite update included encrypted files that were quickly cracked open to reveal everything about the upcoming collaboration — skins, pickaxes, weapon wraps, pricing and a tentative release window. What the Brainrot set includes The set centers on two viral AI-generated characters that originated on TikTok and have since taken on a life of their own across social media. The full Fortnite Brainrot cosmetic lineup consists of 7 items across multiple categories. Tung Tung Tung Sahur (Skin) — 1,500 V-Bucks Ballerina Cappuccina (Skin) — 1,500 V-Bucks Tung Thunker (Pickaxe) — 800 V-Bucks Ballerina’s Spoon-Erina (Pickaxe) — 800 V-Bucks Tung Tung Tung Wraphur (Weapon Wrap) — 500 V-Bucks Wrappuccina (Weapon Wrap) — 500 V-Bucks Fortnite Brainrot Bundle — 3,300 V-Bucks How the bundle pricing works The Brainrot bundle is expected to carry a price tag of around 3,300 V-Bucks, a figure based on the standard 40% discount that Epic Games typically applies when packaging cosmetics together for new skin collections. Purchasing each of the six individual items separately would cost significantly more, making the bundle the more economical option for players who want the complete set. It is worth noting that Epic Games does not confirm pricing before items officially appear in the item shop, so these figures are based on dataminer estimates and the pricing patterns observed across recent collaborations. There is also a possibility that Epic prices the Brainrot set lower than usual given that these characters do not come from a major established intellectual property. Unlike a Marvel, Star Wars or major gaming crossover, the Brainrot characters are TikTok-born creations, which could lead Epic to adjust its pricing structure downward. If that happens, the bundle cost could drop meaningfully from the projected 3,300 V-Bucks. When the Brainrot set is expected to go live According to dataminer ShiinaBR, the rumored release date for the Fortnite Brainrot set is April 1, 2026, which would place it in the item shop when the daily reset occurs at 5 PM PT / 8 PM ET. It is important to flag that ShiinaBR described the date as “rumored” rather than confirmed, so there remains a degree of uncertainty about the exact timing. Assuming the April 1 date holds, here is when the set is expected to go live across all major regions: North America (PT) at 5 PM on April 1, North America and Canada (ET) at 8 PM on April 1, Brazil (BRT) at 9 PM on April 1, United Kingdom (GMT) at 1 AM on April 2, Europe (CET) at 2 AM on April 2, Japan (JST) at 9 AM on April 2, Australia (AEDT) at 11 AM on April 2 and New Zealand (NZDT) at 1 PM on April 2. The Brainrot set represents one of the more unconventional additions to the Fortnite item shop in recent memory, bringing a pair of characters whose popularity was built entirely on social media virality rather than any traditional entertainment franchise. Whether that novelty translates into strong sales will be one of the more interesting data points of the current season. Source: VICE/Waypoint.
